title: Chathurthi practice - MPH Hall
summary: Air conditioning will be available daily from 6:00 PM to 8:00 PM through 18 September. The hall remains available without AC at other times.
body: We are delighted to see so many residents participating in the Chathurthi event. To make practice sessions comfortable, the MPH Hall air conditioning will run daily from 6:00 PM to 8:00 PM through 18 September. Please plan your practice sessions accordingly. You may also use the hall at other times without air conditioning.

title: Water tank cleaning for Blocks A & B
summary: Water supply will be paused for three hours while the overhead tanks are cleaned.
body: Water supply to Blocks A and B will be unavailable from 10:00 AM to 1:00 PM on 12 September while the overhead tanks are cleaned. Please store sufficient water in advance and keep taps closed during the maintenance window.

title: General body meeting
summary: Residents are invited to review this quarter’s updates and upcoming community priorities.
body: The quarterly general body meeting will be held at the MPH Hall. The agenda includes maintenance updates, festival planning and an open resident discussion. Please arrive ten minutes early so we can begin on time.

title: Renew your vehicle sticker
summary: Submit updated vehicle details to the association office by 25 September.
body: Residents with vehicles are requested to renew their society parking stickers. Please bring a copy of the registration certificate and your resident ID to the association office by 25 September.
